pattern_summary.name: Declared Proposal Patch Records Still in Authority Space
pattern_summary.interpretation: Proposal or induction records remain plausibly selectable as live authority because patch-record lookup does not yet bound them away from current state.

pattern_summary.name: Partial Patch Records Without Clean Live Boundary
pattern_summary.interpretation: Partial records need their own bounded treatment because partial status is neither clean history nor clean live settlement.

pattern_summary.name: Executed Records Still Typed as Proposal
pattern_summary.interpretation: Execution completion alone has not been enough to remove proposal typing from authority-sensitive patch records.

pattern_summary.name: Applied Records Still Typed as Historical
pattern_summary.interpretation: Applied historical records remain a distinct current-versus-history problem because the repository preserves them as accessible patch authority surfaces.

pattern_summary.name: Active Schema Versus Living Campaign Registry
pattern_summary.interpretation: This singleton is the smallest bounded live Q3 component and cleanest next resolution target.

pattern_summary.name: Duplicate Patch Identity Alias Pair
pattern_summary.interpretation: These items do not belong in live Q3 because the root problem is duplicate identity, not live-versus-history classification.
